column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a base that names nothing, or no base at all, cannot be told, status 2 and nothing printed, or a typo would read as current
a branch both behind and owing adds two rows, behind first and then owed, or one of the two reports would be lost
a branch that does not hold origin/main's commit is behind, status 0, naming the base and both commits, or a stale branch would land unannounced
a branch that owes rows and is not behind adds exactly one would-refuse row, or the debt would leave no record
a change outside every trigger owes nothing, or a docs branch would be told it owes a version
a change under engine/ that bumps no version and reruns nothing owes both rows, in table order, or the landing that forgot them goes unnamed
a final row with no newline is read, and printed ending in one, or the last recipe in a table would vanish or run into the next line
a five-cell row is refused as cells alone, or a stray tab would carry a column past the schema
a keyed-union arg that is not a positive integer is refused as arg, or the union would key on a column that does not exist
a keyed-union row is refused on a path of every protected category, or the rule would bind one resolver kind and leave the others open
a kind the engine does not define is refused as kind, or a table could invent its own way to land a path
a land.tsv in any directory is one by its basename, and a row added to some/dir/land.tsv escapes as verifier
a lifted scoped row is written to says.log with the command
a narrowing path that is not a valid ERE is refused as path, or grep would match it against nothing and the narrowing row would narrow nothing
a project outside any repository has no base table: status 1, and nothing on stdout or stderr, or a file on disk would pass for the base
a project path spelled through a dot-dot is resolved before its table is looked up, or the same project would read two ways
a project with no land.tsv at origin/main has no table: status 1, no rows and nothing malformed, or an absent table would read as a broken one
a report writer that dies on an unset variable is still reached from the judge's shell, or the containment asserted next is never exercised
a rerun row whose command is the dash is refused as arg, or the actor would settle the path by running nothing
a resolver path that is an ERE, absolute, dot-dot, dash-led, slash-ended, double-slashed or the dash itself is refused as path, or it would bind a path no change can equal
a row added in the working tree only is not read, or an uncommitted edit would rewrite the recipe
a row committed on local main while origin/main is behind it is not read, or the base would be whatever the local branch says
a row ending in a CR is refused as cells alone, or a reader keeping the CR would bind an arg no other reader sees
a row that exists only on the branch or only in the working tree is never owed, or a pull request could invent a debt the base does not hold
a row the schema refuses at the base is reported in the owed row by its line and reason, or a broken table would pass for a clean one
a row whose trigger is - is never owed, not even when a file named - changes and its path is untouched, or the dash would read as a path
a row with an empty cell is refused as cells alone and not as a kind, or a reader collapsing the empty cell would shift every cell after it
a row with several faults reports each of them in the order path, trigger, arg, protected, duplicate, or a fixed fault would uncover another one round later
a second row on the same path is refused as duplicate and the first is the one read, or one path would have two recipes
a session row on every protected path is accepted, or a table could not route those paths to a session at all
a three-cell row is refused as cells alone and read by no one, or a reader would invent its missing arg
a trigger naming a file owes its row when that very file changes, or file triggers would bind nothing
a trigger with a doubled slash, a dot-dot or a space is refused as trigger, or it would match changes nobody meant
a version bump alone still owes red.tsv, since plugin.json is itself under engine/, or the bump would excuse the rerun
a version-above row on .github/actions/a/action.yml is refused as protected, execute, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on .github/workflows/gate.yml is refused as protected, execute, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on a near neighbour of a protected path is accepted, or the rule would refuse by resemblance and not by the list
a version-above row on engine/harness/felix is refused as protected, trust-base, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on engine/harness/hooks/pre-tool is refused as protected, trust-base, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on engine/harness/lib/escape.sh is refused as protected, trust-base, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on engine/harness/lib/land-table.sh is refused as protected, trust-base, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on engine/harness/templates/schemas.tsv is refused as protected, escape-table, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on engine/hooks/hooks.json is refused as protected, trust-base, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on exceptions.tsv is refused as protected, exception, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/autonomy is refused as protected, authority, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/autonomy.commission is refused as protected, authority, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/capabilities is refused as protected, commission-table, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/exceptions.tsv is refused as protected, exception, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/gate.sh is refused as protected, trust-base, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/land.tsv is refused as protected, land-table, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/qualification.tsv is refused as protected, escape-table, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/risk.tsv is refused as protected, escape-table, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
a version-above row on projects/p/stack.tsv is refused as protected, commission-table, or the landing actor could settle that path without a session
adding a row to a land table escapes as verifier, or a branch could grant the actor a path and merge green
an arg on a version-above, insertions-union, session or founder row is refused as arg, or a cell the kind never reads would pass as meaningful
an empty base or one that names nothing cannot be computed, status 2 and nothing printed, or a typo would read as nothing owed
and a CR inside a cell is cells too, never kind, or the reason would depend on where the CR fell
and a branch that has merged origin/main is not behind, status 1 and nothing printed, or every current branch would be reported
and a checkout whose HEAD holds no commit cannot be told either, status 2, or a fresh branch would read as current
and a real attempt still writes its row when the session exported FELIX_MERGE_DRY_RUN=1, or a session could silence the report by its environment
and a refusal carries its line in the file, comments counted, or the founder is sent to the wrong line
and an unknown kind is that row's only reason, its bad path and trigger unsaid, or the refusal would judge columns no kind defines
and exits 1 for a sibling of an entry and for a gate.sh one directory too deep, or a star would span a slash and the base would swallow its neighbours
and felix_land_malformed reports that refused row by its line and exits 1, or a table that cannot be read would pass for a clean one
and felix_land_malformed_in refuses none of them and exits 0, or the design's own table would read as broken
and felix_land_malformed_in refuses none of them and exits 0, or the home's own table would bind nothing
and felix_land_protected prints nothing and exits 1 for each of those neighbours, or it could not say a path is ordinary
and felix_land_rows prints its accepted rows and leaves out the one refused, or a broken row would bind a path
and from inside it both starred entries still match as patterns, or the trust base would depend on the caller's directory
and it adds exactly one would-refuse row to that project's says.log, or the behind branch would leave no record
and it fails closed the same way with the escape list or the execute list blanked, or with the lister gone
and its data rows are those seven, verbatim and in order, so a drifted row is shown by name and not only by a hash
and land.tsv is named once among the escape tables, as a basename, or a project's table under a name the engine does not know would be missed
and says why: its rows exempt things from a check, which is why growth is not free there
and so is a founder row on every one of them, or the founder could not keep them
and so is a rerun row, or a command would rewrite a protected path unattended
and so is an insertions-union row, or a protected table could be landed by concatenation
and that row, committed on a branch origin/main does not hold, is not read, or a pull request could rewrite the recipe that lands it
and the owed row, or land-table.sh does not bring the table reader into the judge's shell
and the schema still refuses a resolver on projects/p/gate.sh from there, or a table checked in the wrong directory would pass
and the schema then refuses a version-above row on that path as protected, unknown, or the fail-closed word would protect nothing
and the table validator accepts it under its schemas.tsv row, or schema-check would fail the gate
and the validator refuses a three-cell row in a land table as cells, exit 1, or schema-check would pass a row the reader splits wrong
and with it, the same call lifts
and writes the behind row there, or escape.sh does not bring land-table.sh and say.sh into the judge's shell
any trigger on a session or founder row is refused as trigger, or a path the actor may never write could be owed
but a row refused as cells claims no path, so the next row on that path stands, or a broken line would disable a good one
but an unknown kind on a path an earlier row binds is a duplicate as well, or a second recipe for one path would go unnamed
but not when a file it merely prefixes changes, since only a trigger ending in a slash names a directory
but with the commission list blanked it says unknown and exits 0, or a missing list would let a resolver through
commenting a row out escapes as verifier, or a hash mark would remove a row unseen
comments, a commented-out row and blank lines are not rows, or a note in the table would bind a path
creating a land table with a row where the base had none escapes as verifier, or a new project's first recipe would land unseen
deleting a land table that had rows escapes as verifier, or every narrowing row in it would go at once unseen
editing one cell of a row in place escapes as verifier, or a narrowing row could be turned into a resolver unseen
felix-home's land.tsv holds the design's seven rows, by the hash of its data rows, or the table the founder arms is not the one designed
felix_land_protected finds an ordinary engine path unprotected while its lists are loaded, exit 1 and no word
felix_land_rows_in prints felix-home's seven rows exactly as written, or the landing actor would read a table the founder never armed
felix_land_trust_base exits 0, printing nothing, for an instance of each of the fourteen trust-base entries, or the schema could not refuse a resolver there
felix_land_would_refuse on a behind branch prints nothing on stdout or stderr and returns 0, or it could not sit inside the merge boundary unseen
felix_merge_blockers on a behind and owing branch writes both would-refuse rows on a real attempt and none on a dry run, or the boundary never reports them
lib/land-table.sh exists and no line of it is one of felix-home's rows, or the engine would name a project's recipe
naming each owed path with its kind and trigger, in table order, at HEAD, or the row would not say what is owed
once origin/main holds the table, felix_land_table_at_base prints it as that ref holds it, or the base could not be read at all
recorded under the session it ran in, with felix merge as its cause, or the row could not be joined to the attempt
removing a row escapes as verifier, or dropping a narrowing row would hand its path to the actor unseen
saying the branch is behind origin/main, or the CLI hands the report a base other than the one it compared
saying which branch is behind which base, by both commits, or the row would not say what to merge
schemas.tsv declares land.tsv a tree table of path, kind, trigger and arg that may be empty, or every land.tsv would be an undeclared table

scoped: a working directory that holds the checkout

scoped: under set -e a cd inside a chain can still fall through
scoped: under set -e a lone cd on its own line is final
the exemption tables are exactly ecosystem.tsv and land.tsv, or any change to a land table would not reach a person
the judge alone: a scratch path is throwaway
the kinds are engine constants, the design's six, with session and founder the narrowing two, or a kind could be added without an engine change
the repository's toplevel is not a project, so a land.tsv at the root of origin/main is never read as one
the same change with the version bumped and red.tsv rewritten owes nothing, or a row would stay owed after it was paid
the same reader reaching its end would lift
turning a comment into a row escapes as verifier, or deleting a hash mark would add a row unseen
while a directory trigger ending in a slash and a file trigger are accepted on a version-above row, or felix-home's own rows could not be written
while an ERE on a founder row is accepted and printed as written, backslash included, or the design's own founder row would be lost
while it adds exactly one would-refuse row to the widget's says.log, or cmd_merge never reaches the report
while keyed-union on column 2 and a rerun command with spaces and <B> are accepted, or felix-home's own rows could not be written
with no origin/main the table is not read at all, local main's copy included, or a local branch could stand in for the base
with no session variable the would-refuse row says unknown in the session column, or it would carry an empty cell
